Pole equal-distance radius ρ solves ρ³+6ρ²-40=0. λ(ρ)=0, λ’(ρ)=(a-α)/(a+ρ)²>0. The primitive irreducible nonmonic polynomial 25t³-195t²+534t-353 of t=2cos(2θ(ρ)) precludes t being integral and proves irrational θ(ρ)/π. Lower amplitude barrier and compact finite-cover rotation hitting give matching asymptotics lim(s-ρ)k*(s)=[(a+ρ)²/(a-α)]log(U/W)=3.809808603810598... . Exact nilpotent pure-birth R(sG) coefficient gives a finite negative entry for each s>ρ. Independent numeric high-precision pole/onset examples and inspected symbolic verifier support but do not prove the continuum limit.
